0.original: Bodwine is looking for an adventurer to help with a pest problem.

1.original: The mitelings near Treespeak Stables are disconcerting the young chocobos, disrupting their training. Slay six of the vilekin and set the aspiring steeds at ease.

2.original: You have purged the Twelveswood of six disruptive mitelings. Return to Treespeak Stables and inform Bodwine of your success.

3.original: Thanks to your valiant efforts, the trainers can resume their work with the young chocobos. Perhaps one will serve as a famous adventurer's trusted companion someday...

48.original: If ye got a mind to make yerself useful, why don't ye cull some mitelin's fer us?

49.original: We train a lot o' chocobos here, see, and the young'uns go wild when they get a sniff of a mitelin'. Some even throw their bloomin' riders!

50.original: Let me tell ye, it ain't easy trainin' a chocobo when she drops ye on yer head every time she sees a shadow. We've been gettin' nowhere with the birds, lately. If ye could rid us of a few mitelin's, we'd be in yer debt.

51.original: Thank ye fer the help! We can finally get back to trainin' the young birds.

52.original: Chocobos're skittish by nature, see, and trainin' 'em takes a deal o' patience. It don't make the task any easier that soldiers and adventurers tend to ride 'em <hex:021A020203>towards<hex:021A020103> danger rather than away from it...

53.original: Anyroad, we're grateful fer the help. Here's a small token of our gratitude.
